title: Odile and the Protocol
author: Jonah Brightwater
blurb: Oscar Quintana, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
